Kento Alpha 0.5, build 826

In this build

  • The manual: Help > Kento manual, in the app, with search, and Help > Open PDF manual. The Properties help button opens a node's page; each Settings page has a help icon to its section.
  • The Viewer's downscale: 1:2 to 1:16, from bar 2 or Viewer > Downscale, works the comp out smaller for that Viewer and shows it at full size, at about twice the speed at 1:2. Each node scales its own pixel controls, as do Roto and RotoPaint, GridWarp and Bezier; the info bar reads the size worked out at, and the playback cache holds frames at that size.
  • A new comp starts with the classic linear and sRGB colour management, as a new Nuke script does: the Viewer clips at 1 instead of rolling bright values off. A comp that names its own config keeps it.
  • Open, save, import and export in Kento's own dialog: favourites you can remove and reorder, projects of folders that fold away, recent folders, a preview, Version up.
  • Closing a comp or quitting asks in Kento's own dialog, once for every unsaved comp; Revert to saved asks too.
  • Blur: a size slider, x and y joined or split (every knob of that kind), finer scrubbing, and disc, exponential and fast gaussian filters beyond Nuke's four; they go to a .nk as groups Nuke renders the same.
  • The comp's sound: an audio lane under the Timeline with its waveform and volume, to and from a .nk.
  • The Generative group: Generate, VeryCanny and the tools for generated footage (Deband, AutoDeband, Cambi, Deflicker, Halation, Grain and more) together, in the menus and on the toolbar, which opens each group's menu as you roll over it once one is open.
  • Kento's own nodes: Kento's tiles and full panels, plain labels, units beside the values.
  • Several nodes selected: one colour for all (a stripe on each tile), and Locked: a locked node's panel takes no input.
  • Interface brightness as any grey, Dark to Light; scrollbars where a panel or a Settings page is cropped; sticky notes go see-through over nodes.
  • Fixed: the Kento menu losing About and Check for updates; the Viewer menu's channels and compare; the transport's J, K, L and arrow keys; preferences kept however Settings closes; a .ko keeps the comp's colour settings; Edit inside over a Bento's Presets icon.

The first build for compositors to try. It opens and saves Nuke-compatible scripts, and is meant for

new work as well as for playing old comps back.

Comps

  • Opens .nk scripts: all 1,388 scripts in Autonomy's census open, with 99% of their nodes built. Saves Nuke-compatible .nk, and .ko, Kento's own file, which keeps everything (tracks, solves, Kento's own settings).
  • Expressions on knobs, Nuke-compatible: worked out live where Kento can, and kept in the script where it can't yet. Known safe Python from comps runs.
  • Autosave, and recovery of an autosave newer than the comp.

Nodes

  • Nuke-compatible nodes, by the names compositors know and checked pixel for pixel: merges, grades, transforms (concatenating), blurs, keyers, Roto and RotoPaint, Read and Write (EXR, DPX, PNG, TIFF, JPEG, ProRes, H.264), 3D cards, cameras and ScanlineRender, and more.
  • New nodes start from your recent or most common values, or their defaults.

The Viewer

  • Up to four Viewers; compare and wipe; guides, aspect masks, rulers; the data passes (depth, motion, normals, IDs, position); Cryptomatte picking; pixel info.
  • On-screen controls for transforms, corner pins, crops, ramps, flares, the Tracker and the Sampler.

Roto and paint

  • Draw Bezier, B-spline, rectangle and ellipse shapes; edit points and tangents, key them (auto-key), set colour, feather and opacity.
  • Paint with a brush, eraser, clone or reveal, with pen pressure; a clone's source moved, turned and scaled. Edit painted strokes afterwards in the Layers panel: their lifetime, opacity, brush, colour and clone source; several at once.
  • The Layers panel: layers, shapes and strokes, renamed, duplicated and reordered by dragging.

Tracking

  • The Tracker tracks in Kento, with tolerance, hand-over to another feature keeping the offset, rejoining the original, and filling gaps from other tracks. Forward and back, or multipass.
  • Tracks over time: a lane per track. Exports to Transform and CornerPin2D, linked or baked.

Expressions

  • The expression helper (Utility menu): Link, Choose, Offset in time, Hold, Wiggle, Oscillate, Ramp, Step, Loop, Clamp and Size, with a live curve; pixel recipes for keys and masks.
  • The pick-whip: drag a knob's state mark onto another knob to link it, or onto a node in the Node Graph to choose one of its knobs.

Help

  • Report a problem: what happened, the comp, the log and the Mac's details, saved as a .zip and filed in the studio bug tracker.

Not yet

  • The comp's own proxy, for renders at a smaller size: the Viewer's downscale works the comp out smaller for the Viewer only.
  • The manual's pictures: its pages say where each goes.
  • Paint's blur, sharpen, smear, dodge and burn; a clone source from another frame.
  • Roto open splines.

Kento Alpha 0.5, build 748

In this build

  • Playback: each Viewer keeps frames ready to show, made in the background ahead of the playhead, and plays from them at the comp's rate. The Timeline's green line shows what's held; it fills as frames are made. Set its size in Settings > Performance > Memory > playback cache. An edit empties it; it fills again.
  • Playback keeps to the comp's rate: the Node Graph no longer redraws every frame while playing, and the Timeline no longer re-lays out the window.
  • Faster frames: Radial, CheckerBoard, Noise, Ramp, Grid, Glow, Saturation and other nodes built on Kento's pixel expressions work much faster (Radial 13 times, CheckerBoard 3 times), with the same pixels.
  • Comps open with the picture fitted to the Viewer.
  • Sticky notes look like notes: paper colours, resize from their edges and corners, opacity, a pin, and text that stays readable when zoomed out.
  • Gizmos: Settings > Paths > gizmo folders; File > Import > Gizmo..., or drop a .gizmo on the Node Graph. A gizmo opens as a group with its controls in their tabs; any group's controls now show in Properties.
  • Curve Editor: Snap > Grid, every N frames and on a value step, kept between sessions; the scale percentages sit by the handle you drag; Shift+I opens the key sidebar; buffer and pinned curves are saved with the comp.
  • Shuffle: New layer... in the out menus. Timeline keyframes are amber.
  • Fixed: undoing an imported gizmo could crash Kento; background renders and Flipbook QuickTimes of saved comps failed; QuickTimes came out one frame long; the Scopes didn't follow the Viewer's solo; notes opened from a file were drawn as large grey squares; a .ko now keeps marks, backdrop opacity and pins.

Kento Alpha 0.1, build 718

In this build

  • Curve Editor, to its board: the ruler with marks, a finer grid with a value gutter and legend, the curve list with folds, and a key sidebar (Panels > Key sidebar) for the chosen keys' frame, value and tangents.
  • Curve Editor: Duplicate keys (Cmd+D) at the playhead, Copy and Paste (Cmd+C, Cmd+V), and snapping to other keys and marks. Drag inside the selection box to move the keys.
  • Curve Editor: buffer curves (Keep buffer, Swap with buffer) and pinned reference curves. Curve menu: Smooth values, Low-pass filter... and Bake....
  • Curve Editor: the Viewer's frames in a strip under the ruler.
  • Playback area, compact: a 24 px info bar and a one-line Timeline, which folds into two thin lines on narrow windows.
  • Motion: Add on top keeps the knob's keys editable, with the motion's amplitude and frequency as keyable knobs. The Motion window pulses at marks and keys its other settings over time.
  • New nodes, checked against Nuke: LightWrap, CameraShake3 (with Randomize seed), Grain (with its stock presets), VolumeRays, RolloffContrast, HueShift, SoftClip, CompareMetaData. They work with no other software installed.
  • Write: Limit to range. Reformat: turn. Premult and Unpremult: invert. DiskCache: Precache.
  • Flipbook: plays movies backwards. Scopes follow the Viewer's A side and its soloed channel.
  • Comps open at their saved frame. Number fields scrub while typing; Up and Down step.
  • Fixed: Mitchell filtering now matches; Noise's octaves at small sizes; a text's shadow at opacity 0.
